note: Inyo NF campground on Big Pine Creek under pines, aspens and cottonwoods at the end of Glacier Lodge Rd, about 10 mi west of Big Pine; sites 021, 022, 024 and 029 sit beside the creek. The North Fork trail to Big Pine Lakes and the Palisade Glacier starts up the road. --Claude
